name: @podium/logger
description: The one logging core every Podium runtime shares [spec:2026-08-11-logging-strategy-design]: namespaced loggers, five levels, child-bound structured context, the NDJSON record shape, and the fail-open sink fan-out with the console and ring-buffer sinks. Dependency-free and browser-safe by construction — the whole package is a declared browser entrypoint and is held to it by scripts/audit-browser-reach.ts. Node-only sinks (file, rotation, stdout) land behind their own ./node subpath, never here.
